suppress.notes:
Added 2026-08-23. CVE-2020-27225 is a privilege issue in the Eclipse IDE's p2 provisioning UI, which is reached by installing software into a running Eclipse workbench. The packages it is reported against here are OSGi runtime bundles that the Eclipse JDT formatter resolves, and this repository loads exactly one type out of that tree, the Java code formatter. No p2 code is on the classpath and no workbench exists to install into, so the vulnerable path cannot be entered from here.
The report is a CPE collision: Dependency-Check maps every org.eclipse.platform coordinate to cpe:2.3:a:eclipse:platform, which is the identifier of the Eclipse Platform product rather than of any one bundle, so the advisory matches whatever version each bundle happens to carry. There is no fixed version to move to, because none of these bundles is what the advisory is about.

Added 2026-08-23. CVE-2014-125035 is a cross-site request forgery in a web application plugin named "jobs-plugin". It is matched here against org.eclipse.platform:org.eclipse.core.jobs, which is the Eclipse background-job scheduler and shares nothing with it but the word "jobs". The two are unrelated products, so no version of this package is affected and no upgrade applies.
